card.name: Endings of surnames and disclaimer phrases
card.fires_on: The last piece of a historical person's surname split into parts (Wood-son, Men-cken, Big-elow), and some words inside 'not intended to provide' disclaimers.

modes.label: Split surnames
modes.description: Final piece of a famous person's name, often just before birth and death years or a bracket.

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: Words inside a 'not intended to provide medical advice' notice.

card.plain: It fires on the closing part of a long surname and on some words in standard disclaimer sentences.
